name: Reduce fade-cli bloat by extracting optional commands
description: fade-cli grew from ~5000 to 13,600 lines in 3 days. Many features are optional (dashboard, council, discover, workspace). Extract these to separate scripts in fade/lib/ that fade-cli calls. Core script should be <6000 lines.

userStories.title: Extract cmd_dashboard to fade/lib/dashboard.sh
userStories.description: Dashboard is self-contained. Move it out of fade-cli.
acceptanceCriteria: fade-cli cmd_dashboard() becomes a thin wrapper that sources the lib

userStories.title: Extract cmd_council to fade/lib/council.sh
userStories.description: Council is self-contained. Move it out of fade-cli.
acceptanceCriteria: fade/lib/council.sh contains all council brief generation

userStories.title: Extract cmd_workspace to fade/lib/workspace.sh
userStories.description: Workspace/multi-repo is self-contained. Move it out.

userStories.title: Verify fade-cli is under 6000 lines
userStories.description: After extraction, the core script should be manageable.
acceptanceCriteria: All extracted libs are < 1500 lines each
userStories.notes: Partial: Extracted libs work correctly (3/4 criteria pass), but bin/fade-cli still 12463 lines vs < 6000 target. Need to extract cmd_export (2508), cmd_map (883), cmd_update (881), cmd_discover (507) to reach goal.

technicalNotes.rationale: Careful refactoring across multiple files. Medium complexity.
